review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Fix explicit phone input transport and accurate bounded send feedback
review.notes: User identifies current dev21 and HQ22. Five exact phone text length/SHA8 matches remain in their correctly bound Codex queues while metadata active/direct true. HTTP collapses queue acceptance to bool/status ok and RN fetch/body has no send deadline. Use authenticated exact thread metadata and one stable request ID: explicit phone text may steer an active eligible turn or start a loaded idle turn; do not resume threads or operate old queues. Ordinary HQ/CLI queue behavior unchanged. Only definitive unsupported API permits legacy queue fallback; timeouts/generic rejections never replay. Preserve draft/menu/hold, same-home/backend and exact binding guards. Add structured receipt and bounded RN full response wait, without claiming execution/completion or auto retry. Synthetic tests only; no live input, restore, service restart/deploy or release. Source first self-review then independent review/normal final gates. Follow-up review before changing the existing MSD-005 fixture: exact f38 cloud run42959182675 failed only the terminal-to-Chat receipt assertion because the fixture flushed microtasks but did not wait for the two production requestAnimationFrame callbacks. Use controlled timers and explicitly advance those two frames before querying ChatView; preserve all send-count, stable sendID, delivery, retry and stale-result assertions and original test timeout. This is deterministic fixture scheduling, not evidence that a real device send failed. Keep the original CI failure.

cases.description: Native explicit user input selects exact active/idle operation without replay
cases.setup: Fake authenticated same-home server and real protocol loop; active exact turn, idle loaded, legacy and notLoaded metadata
cases.action: Submit explicit user inputs; vary flags, direct support, latest turn mismatch, unknown method, lost ack, identity check, timeout and failed turn
cases.expected: Active uses one exact expectedTurnId steer; loaded idle uses one start with original stable message ID and input; legacy returns honest queue receipt; notLoaded never resume; permissions/cwd/model unchanged; flags, state change and ambiguous writes never queue/replay; no real server input.

cases.description: Phone ingress opts in and preserves native delivery outcome and guards
cases.setup: Injected exact native target/guard, plain and agent routing, accepted persisted native receipts
cases.action: Run shared dispatch and phone opts with explicit user input and compare ordinary CLI/HQ default
cases.expected: Only phone explicit submitted text opts into direct user semantics. Receipt keeps queued vs active/start accepted; persistent retries preserve known outcome. Native failure never types fallback; draft/menu/hold/identity/idempotency unchanged.

cases.description: HTTP send returns actual receipt with existing auth/access policy

cases.expected: Preferred receipt returned as additive JSON while legacy clients retain status ok; no mutation when unauthorized, guest out of scope or key invalid; queue acceptance not claimed read/completed; no message body or secrets in diagnostics.

cases.description: App send has a bounded full-response wait and no automatic mutation retry
cases.setup: Mock fetch and response.json independently ignoring cancellation, fake timers, known send ID
cases.action: Hang transport or body; resolve/reject late, normal receipt, HTTP refusal, malformed legacy response
cases.expected: Full send settles at finite deadline and aborts network; late success cannot overwrite timeout; only one fetch, original send ID retained by caller for explicit retry; refusal and legacy success remain compatible.

cases.description: Conversation and Terminal reflect receipt and release endless Sending
cases.setup: Real DetailView/ChatView with fake API, timers and transcript; terminal/chat modes and prior identical prompt
cases.action: Send queued/accepted/submitted/legacy requests, timeouts and overlapping late errors while switching target
cases.expected: Queued is labeled queued awaiting next turn, accepted means received not read/completed; finite network deadline keeps text and explicit same-ID retry; late old response/failure cannot replace a newer pending attempt; transcript confirmation retires the correct echo; no resends, no queue deletion, no draft/approval bypass.
